newsitem.title: USA: Archer Daniels says profits drop in latest quarter.
newsitem.headline: Archer Daniels says profits drop in latest quarter.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co. Tuesday reported sharply lower earnings for its fiscal third quarter.

The agribusiness giant had earnings for the quarter ended March 31 of $61.2 million, or 11 cents a share. Revenue figures will be available next month, Archer Daniels said. A year earlier it earned $163.3 million, or 30 cents a share.
The company did not comment on its earnings report.
For the nine months, Archer Daniels earned $254.7 million, or 47 cents a share, compared with $552.3 million, or $1 a share a year earlier.

Net income for the nine months includes a pre-announced charge of 32 cents per share for fines and litigation settlements arising from the Justice Department's antitrust investigation of the company's lysine and citric acid products, as well as resolution of a securities lawsuit filed by ADM shareholders.
Archer Daniels stock was up 12.5 cents to close at $17.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
